'''KB's home''' was the home of the [[human]] [[youngling]] [[KB]] on the [[planet]] [[At Attin]] during the [[New Republic Era]]. The house had a garage where KB could work on her and her friend [[Fern]]'s [[Fern and KB's hoverbike|hoverbike]].<ref name="Real Adventure" /> In [[9 ABY]]<ref name="SCDate">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> they were both in the garage discussing where to get a new [[power converter]] for the hoverbike when the human, [[Bonjj Phalfa]] stopped in front of the house to taunt their hoverbike.<ref name="Real Adventure" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
KB's home first appeared in "[[This Could Be a Real Adventure]]"<ref name="Real Adventure" /> the first episode of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'', which aired on [[December 2]], [[2024]].<ref name="Early">{{SW|url=news/skeleton-crew-premiere-date|text=''Star Wars: Skeleton Crew'' Will Debut Early|date=2024-11-26}}</ref>
